title: Yeasty Flaky German Sweetcorn Bake
description: A traditional German brunch dish featuring sweetcorn, salt-bake, and a yeasty flaky crust, perfect for a kosher-friendly meal
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and salt
Gradually add warm water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour
Punch down the dough and roll out into a 1/4 inch thick sheet
In a separate bowl, mix together sweetcorn kernels, sugar, eggs, and milk
Spread the sweetcorn mixture evenly over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges
Fold the edges of the dough over the filling to form a crust
Brush the crust with melted butter and bake for 35 minutes, or until golden brown
